gaps.where: Home (Action Center): each card's main button (Create lead, Add to its instructions, Got it, Move, Mark done, Approve/Send on a teammate draft) and the record it opens
gaps.gap: what_needs_attention's itemResult (tools-attention.ts:153-176) and the per-turn context (context.ts:161-172, prompt.ts:166-177) pass only id, kind, title, chips, value, urgent, detail, assignee, canHandle and handsFreeOsSendsAt. attention.list already returns subject {type,id}, personId, leadId, conversationId, appointmentId, addonAlert {alertId, addonName, needsAck, href} and handleLabel (schemas/attention.ts:63-94, 126), and the tools drop all of them. Home's buttons run on those ids: referralId, leadId, lessonId, appointmentId and draftId all come from item.subject.id, and the add-on alert uses addonAlert.alertId (attention-actions.tsx:252, 279, 300, 324, 350, 515). Three of these ids can be found no other way. Nothing lists referrals or teammate lessons. The bell's add-on alerts are read from attention.list too (notifications-provider.tsx:151), so do_referral_create_lead, do_teammate_lesson_apply/dismiss and do_addon_alert_acknowledge can't be used from a Home card at all. read_attention_for_record takes only lead/person/conversation/appointment/task (schemas/attention.ts:190). Three ids can be reached with a second lookup: draftId through list_teammate_drafts (core tools-content.ts:345-361), and leadId or appointmentId through search_customers, list_leads or list_appointments.
gaps.fix: Fixed: what_needs_attention gives each item what it is about (subject: the referral, lesson, draft, approval, task, estimate or invoice, with its id), its customer, lead, conversation and appointment ids, an add-on alert’s id and whether it still waits to be seen, button (the words on its own button), buttonTool (the tool that presses that button, with its ids: do_referral_create_lead, do_teammate_lesson_apply, do_addon_alert_acknowledge, do_lead_catch_up, do_wallet_top_up, update_appointment, update_customer, decide_teammate_draft or answer_workflow_approval) and opens, the whole link to its page (buttonToolOf and itemResult in apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-attention.ts). The per-turn context names each item’s subject and id too.

gaps.where: Home: the full Needs you list, and its folded groups ("N more like this")
gaps.gap: The auditor is wrong that there's no kind filter. what_needs_attention takes kind: z.enum(ATTENTION_KINDS) (tools.ts:128), and the worker passes it as kinds (tools-attention.ts:191), so 'show me the overdue invoices' works up to 8 of that kind. What's real: the output is always cut to TOP=8 plus `more: N` (tools-attention.ts:30, 193, 202), and there's no offset or limit. Past item 8, overall or within one kind, nothing can be read. Home renders every item (action-center.tsx:279-298), and attention.list is not a screen read, so no read_ tool fills the gap.
gaps.fix: Fixed: what_needs_attention takes offset and limit (1 to 50, 8 when left out), numbers rank from where the page starts, and says more and nextOffset, so every item can be read, overall or within one kind. The card still shows 8.

gaps.where: Every screen other than a person, company, lead, conversation, appointment or workflow page: Home, Search, Audit log, Settings → Calendars (booking link), invoices, forms, documents and others
gaps.gap: The ask carries only `page: AssistantPageRecord` (schemas/assistant.ts:318-339). That covers 7 types: person, company, lead, conversation, appointment, workflow and workflow_run, matched from the URL by RECORD_ROUTES/assistantPageRecord (words.ts:413-447). Web and phone both send only that (assistant-provider.tsx:624, mobile chat.ts:521). On every other screen turnText adds the fixed 'No customer, lead or appointment is on screen.' (prompt.ts:322). That includes Home, Search, Audit log, Settings → Calendars, invoices, forms and documents. The Assistant has no idea which page or setting is open. Nothing else in context.ts adds it.
gaps.fix: Add `path: z.string().max(300).optional()` to AssistantAskInput (packages/core/src/schemas/assistant.ts:333). Send usePathname() and its search from the web panel (assistant-provider.tsx:624) and the phone (chat.ts:521, through askHref). In context.ts questionContext, match it against APP_PLACES[].path and SETTINGS_MAP[].path, and take any uuid in the path (the calendar on /settings/calendars/<id>, an invoice, a form). Put it in PromptContext as `place: {label, way, id?}`. In prompt.ts turnText, replace the fixed sentence with 'On screen now: <label> (<way>)' plus the id.

gaps.where: Home: "Handled by HandsFreeOS" / "Handled today" list (who, what, when) and "Coming up from HandsFreeOS" (with Cancel)
gaps.gap: The handled list really is missing. what_needs_attention never passes includeHandled (tools-attention.ts:189-192), so attention.list's `handled` is always [] for it. Only the handledToday count reaches the model (line 200), and HandledByHandsFree's who, what and when list (handled-today.tsx:78-90) can't be read item by item. Scheduled messages are a partial gap. They are open items (view.ts:341-356), and itemResult already gives an id and handsFreeOsSendsAt for any that sits in the top 8 (tools-attention.ts:173-175), so do_attention_cancel_auto works for those. Scheduled items below the top 8 can't be seen, and the `scheduled` array that 'Coming up from HandsFreeOS' shows is dropped.
gaps.fix: Fixed: on its first page what_needs_attention reads attention.list with includeHandled and returns handled (today’s, newest first, up to 20: what was done in core’s words, how, when, byHandsFree for Home’s Handled by HandsFreeOS, and its link) and comingUp (every message HandsFreeOS is about to send: item id, what, which kind, when).

gaps.where: Home: the main button on each kind of card (Top up, Move, Create lead, Mark done, Add to its instructions, Got it, Add address, Approve/Send a teammate draft)
gaps.gap: The what_needs_attention description names only 8 of the ~35 kinds (tools.ts:121). prompt.ts:28 sends every approval to answer_workflow_approval. That tool is only for workflow approval steps (tools.ts:1419-1421), yet ai_approval items include AI teammate drafts (detectors/ai-approval.ts:2,18), which need decide_teammate_draft and Home approves them as drafts (attention-actions.tsx:347-352, 377). For kinds HandsFreeOS won't handle, handle_attention_item returns the LET_HANDLE_REFUSALS sentence (kinds.ts:663-693) or 'Open it on Home…' (tools-attention.ts:291-297, 313-316). Another tool presses that very button: do_wallet_top_up (Top up), do_lead_catch_up (Move), do_referral_create_lead (Create lead), update_appointment outcome done (Mark done), do_teammate_lesson_apply (Add to its instructions), do_addon_alert_acknowledge and update_customer (Add address). wallet_low's refusal, 'Only you can put money on your own balance', and prompt.ts:34 (topping up is listed as something only they can do, so the model calls settings_help) both contradict do_wallet_top_up, which is in SCREEN_ACTIONS (coverage.ts:161) and charges the card on file (commands/wallet.ts:260-263).
gaps.fix: Fixed: each item’s buttonTool names the tool that does what its own button does (Top up, Move, Create lead, Mark done, Add to its instructions, Got it, Add address, Approve a teammate draft or a workflow approval). handle_attention_item’s refusal for a kind HandsFreeOS doesn’t handle offers that button instead (and complete_task for a task), with the tool and ids in its result. The prompt points to buttonTool, and no longer lists topping up the balance as something only the person can do (putting a card on it still is).

gaps.where: Audit log: each row's sentence ("Ava (AI) texted Dana…"), its category, the actor name, and the hidden "Show what HandsFreeOS noticed" rows
gaps.gap: read_audit_list returns raw AuditEntry rows (schemas/audit.ts:45-76): the action code, actor.type, actor.fullName (null for the AI teammate), and before/after JSON. The screen's sentence, category label, actor name and detection flag come from describeAudit, auditCategory, AUDIT_CATEGORY_LABEL, auditActor and isAuditDetection, which live only in apps/web/src/lib/audit-describe.ts. No Assistant file uses them. The model can sometimes find the teammate's name in after.teammate and guess a category from the prefix. But system 'attention_item.*' and attention opened/reopened/resolved/became_urgent rows, which the screen hides until 'Show what HandsFreeOS noticed' is ticked, come back unmarked. gaps.where: Home card: Snooze, Dismiss (with reason) and Assign
gaps.gap: In core, the rule for screen commands is that only risk 0 runs on its own and risk 1 and up waits (screen-actions.ts:32-33, 49). attention.assign is risk 1 (commands/attention.ts:404), so its confirm card is consistent. The auditor's 'risk 0-1 runs on its own' is the add-on rule. attention.snooze and attention.dismiss are risk 0 (commands/attention.ts:229, 322), and update_attention_item still puts them behind Confirm (tools.ts:1485), while do_attention_restore and do_attention_cancel_auto (risk 0) run on their own. That inconsistency is real. But README.md:154 records the confirm card as the design ('can handle, snooze, dismiss or assign an item through a confirm card'). A snooze or dismissal can also cancel a message HandsFreeOS was about to send, which the card warns about (tools-attention.ts:728-732).
gaps.fix: Fixed: set_aside_attention_item snoozes or dismisses at once, as Home does (both risk 0; do_attention_restore puts one back). One HandsFreeOS is about to send a message for refuses with rule attention_stops_auto and goes through update_attention_item’s card instead, since that stops the message. update_attention_item keeps its card for assign. README’s Action Center line says so.
